resources.string: Gray roads turning green as they are driven
Every road you drive turns green
Roadmaxxing maps the roads you drive and shows how much of your city you have discovered.
Drives are recorded automatically and matched to roads right on your phone. Then you get a percentage you can share.
Roadmaxxing never asks you to go faster or farther. The goal is to know your roads, not to rush.
Do not touch your phone while you drive.
Follow the traffic rules and the speed limits, always.
I will drive safely and not use the phone while driving
Roadmaxxing uses your precise location to match your drive to the road you are on.
You only allowed approximate location. Matching a drive to the right road needs precise location.
This permission is turned off. You can turn it on in the system settings.
Roadmaxxing collects location data in the background to detect and record your drives automatically, even when the app is closed or not in use.
The location is used only to match your drives to roads and to work out your progress. It stays on your device.
Next, choose “Allow all the time” in the system dialog or settings.
Motion and activity access lets Roadmaxxing tell when you are in a vehicle, so recording starts without draining your battery.
A quiet notification shows while a drive is being recorded, and a short summary appears after each drive. They are optional, and recording works without them.
